dependency_evidence: evidence/SV2-PRF-03/result.json records the preceding performance package; the ranking contract the packers follow is the kernel's SV2-CTX-02 retrieval rank and SV2-CTX-03 packing, which stay unchanged
evidence_class: mocked: a fixed held out corpus with human review labels and in process packers that follow the kernel ranking contract stand in for brain-api, its graph store and a live model; no embedding, HTTP server or agent runs, and usefulness is the share of injected items a reviewer labelled useful, not a model judgement
interfaces: tests.evaluation.brain_context.evaluate.pack(policy, task, fixture, budget) packs one held out task under one policy: feed_only ranks the fleet by heat with no scope, scoped admits only lexical matches inside the fixture grant after superseded guidance yields to a visible successor, graph adds one hop from source to target over accepted resolved_by, decided_by and related edges whose target is inside the grant; every pack names its omitted superseded and over budget items
evaluate.score grades a pack against the task's expected sources and review labels; out of scope items are counted as scope_leakage and never named, including in the omission lists

evaluate.totals gives context_source_recall, reviewed_usefulness, repeated_mistakes_avoided, scope_leakage, irrelevant_injection, stale_injection, arcs, context_tokens, context_tokens_per_found_source and context_tokens_per_task together

evaluate.qualify(accepted, candidate) qualifies a policy only on a gain in recall, usefulness or repeated mistakes avoided with no regression and no leakage; a change in arcs or context tokens is reported as volume_delta and is never a gain

evaluate.Registry holds the accepted ranking and packing policy for one corpus revision under a file lock: a request carries the whole report, the registry recomputes it from its own corpus and refuses a mismatch, qualifies its totals against the accepted totals itself and ignores any caller verdict, a revert needs the report hash the policy was accepted with, every change is compare and set on the sequence, a reused operation id replays its earlier result and a staged write that never published is discarded on recover
python -m tests.evaluation.brain_context.evaluate [--fixture alpha|beta] [--policy NAME ...] prints the totals for each policy

supported_versions.corpus: sv2-prf-04-corpus-1, two independent fixtures of four held out tasks each
supported_versions.ranking_contract: kernel retrieval rank policy revision 2 semantics without semantic or heat sources: scope before scoring, heat never admits, accepted edges only, edges followed in their stored direction, supersedes is not a similarity edge; the graph_wide and scoped_padded rejection policies break this contract on purpose

states.observed: Cases A, B and C each ran in CI from fresh temporary folders and matched their committed records; case A ran both fixtures, whose corpus hashes differ.
states.accepted: A policy is accepted when the registry publishes a record with the next sequence for the same corpus revision; a qualified verdict alone is not acceptance.
states.committed: The accepted record is written to a staged file, flushed with fsync and renamed over the record; a staged file that was never renamed is not committed.
states.externally_verified: Not yet: no deployed brain-api, graph store or agent consumed these packs; a live comparison on real task outcomes belongs to the G10 rollout gate.

metrics.context_source_recall: expected supporting sources present in the pack over expected sources, summed over the fixture's held out tasks
metrics.reviewed_usefulness: injected items a reviewer labelled useful over all injected items, out of scope items included; an unlabelled item counts as not useful
metrics.repeated_mistakes_avoided: share of incident and superseded guidance tasks whose pack holds every expected source and no stale guidance
metrics.context_tokens: sum of the fixture's token sizes for the injected items, tracked beside usefulness and never used as a gain

rollback_rehearsal.action: Restore the last accepted ranking and packing policy: case C promotes graph, interrupts a revert to scoped after staging, restarts the registry, applies the revert by the same operation id and replays it once more.
rollback_rehearsal.authoritative_objects: The corpus file and its review labels and the published accepted record are authoritative; reports are derived and recomputed from the corpus revision.

remaining_limitations: The packers mirror the kernel ranking contract rather than calling brain-api; semantic similarity and heat sources are not modelled, so the comparison grades lexical seeds and graph expansion only.
The held out questions are authored from incidents, decisions and superseded guidance recorded in this fleet's seat lessons and swarm culture, not sampled from live brain arcs.

The review labels were written by the implementing agent and await human review, recorded in the corpus labels block; usefulness comes from those labels, no agent consumed a pack and no task outcome was measured.
Eight held out tasks over two fixtures are a qualification floor, not a statistically powered sample.
Context tokens are fixture token sizes, not tokenizer counts of rendered pack text.
compatibility: Explicitly local compatibility path: no production module changes; the feed only policy reproduces today's fleet hot arc feed and the scoped policy is the accepted baseline the graph policy is compared against.
authority: Each fixture grant names the actor, role and allowed projects; packs and scores read scope only from that grant, never from an item title or display label.
